title: Schema for Chapter 3.3.8 Stichprobendokumentation der Strukturanalyse
description: The sample table of the Strukturanalyse (BSI Muster-Auditbericht V3.0, Tabelle 22: at least 3 Geschäftsprozesse, 3 Anwendungen, 3 IT-Systeme, 6 Räume/Gebäude/Standorte, 3 Kommunikationsverbindungen), the answer to the optional Netzplan question (Tabelle 23) and a single finding.

rows.description: One row per sample, keyed exactly like the report table headers.

Bezeichnung.description: Kürzel and name of the Zielobjekt as listed in the Strukturanalyse.

Beschreibung.description: The description given in the list.

Anzahl.description: Number of components in the group; '1' if the entry is not a group.

answers.description: One answer: the optional question about the bereinigter Netzplan.

finding.description: A single, structured finding for this section.

category.description: Category of the finding: 'AG' (Minor Deviation), 'AS' (Major Deviation), 'E' (Recommendation), or 'OK'.

description.description: A clear, concise description of the finding, including evidence and document reference.
